# JRE #2329: Ehsan Ahmad

Joe Rogan welcomed comedian and podcast co-host Ehsan Ahmad to the studio on May 29, 2025, for a wide-ranging conversation that touched on Ahmad's work in comedy and media. Ahmad, known for co-hosting "The Solid Show" alongside Deric Poston, brought his perspective on the entertainment industry and the podcast landscape to the conversation.

The episode served as an in-depth look into Ahmad's career and worldview. As a comedian, Ahmad has built a presence in the comedy world while simultaneously establishing himself as a podcast personality through "The Solid Show," which he co-hosts with Poston. This dual career path has positioned him at the intersection of stand-up comedy and long-form audio content, two formats that have become increasingly intertwined in contemporary entertainment.

During the conversation, Rogan and Ahmad engaged in the kind of extended dialogue that has become characteristic of the JRE format. While the episode covered general topics, it allowed for the organic development of ideas and discussion that typically emerges when two people with experience in comedy and podcasting sit down together. The setting provided Ahmad with a platform to discuss his background, his work on "The Solid Show," and his observations about the comedy and podcast industries.

Ahmad's presence on the show reflected the broader trend of comedians using the JRE as a space to discuss their craft and experiences in the entertainment world. As someone who straddles both the traditional comedy circuit and the newer podcast ecosystem, Ahmad represented a generation of comedians who have adapted to multiple platforms and formats. His collaboration with Deric Poston on "The Solid Show" demonstrates how comedians are creating their own content and building audiences independently of traditional media gatekeepers.

The episode itself fit into the pattern of JRE episodes that feature guests from the comedy world, where conversations tend to move fluidly between personal anecdotes, industry observations, and deeper philosophical discussions. These episodes have consistently attracted audiences interested in hearing from entertainers about their creative processes, career decisions, and perspectives on contemporary culture.

Rogan's interview with Ahmad provided listeners with an extended conversation with a working comedian and podcast host at a time when both mediums continue to evolve. The podcast episode captured Ahmad at a point in his career where he is actively creating content across multiple platforms while maintaining a presence in live comedy. For fans of "The Solid Show" and those interested in the comedy podcast space, the appearance offered insight into Ahmad's thinking and background.

The May 29, 2025 episode added to the long list of JRE conversations featuring comedians and content creators who are shaping modern comedy and podcasting. Through this extended format, Rogan and Ahmad explored the landscape of contemporary entertainment and the paths comedians take in building their careers in an era where podcasting and comedy have become deeply connected.
